messages:
Morgan: quick heads-up — proposing a new Playground + docs snippet that demonstrates how to resume interrupted streaming responses (partial-output replay) and how to handle 429s with exponential backoff + checkpointing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

Tia: love it. Is this specific to the new streaming resume API? any SDK changes?

Morgan: yes — using the new resume_stream param on the /v1/streams endpoint and resume_token. Example:

```js
const r = await client.stream.create({
  model: 'redwood/gpt-3.5x',
  prompt: 'Long generation...',
  resume_stream: true,
  onToken: (t) => console.log(t.token)
});
// If 429 occurs, server returns resume_token in header x-resume-token
// then you can call stream.create({resume_token}) to continue
```

Samir: will the Playground be interactive for customers? we should hide resume_token in UI unless opt-in.

Morgan: yep, option gated behind 'Advanced debugging' in Playground. Also want a runnable curl + node snippet for troubleshooting.

Jen-docs: small ask — add a short test that simulates a 429 mid-stream and verifies that resume token is issued and resume works. CI had a flake yesterday in docs build when node12 env timing changed.

Kevin: pinging infra — @deploy-bot any objections to adding a minimal mock plugin to local test harness? we can't call prod streaming for CI.

deploy-bot: infra-note: mock-stream-service added in staging for docs PR testing. usage: ./tools/mock-stream --port 9001

Tia: I left a few nits on the PR (styling + wording around 'checkpoint'). Also suggest linking to the error-ref 429 page and the timeout guidance.

Morgan: thanks — will update. Also need a docs anchor to link from error-ref: /docs/errors#stream-resume. Can someone add that anchor? 

Samir: I'll add the anchor and link. Also adding a short note about privacy: resume_token should be treated as a bearer token (expires after 5 mins).

Jen-docs: LGTM after tests pass. @morgan can you squash the WIP commits? :thumbsup: 

Morgan: will do tonight. Updating PR URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — tests currently failing on flaky timeout in mock harness, looking into it.

Jen-docs: if you need help, I can take the mock harness flake; assign me.

Morgan: assigned. thanks!

Samir: quick follow-up: should we add a short example for SDK retry header 'x-retry-after' handling? some SDKs don't expose header easily.

Tia: yes — add cURL + python snippet showing header read and wait logic.

Morgan: noted — adding. Target for merge: EOD Friday. If we miss, we'll cut a docs patch next week. 

deploy-bot: deploy-preview created at https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai

Morgan: preview looks good locally. Will push final changes after CI green.
